brand_identity.name: Cibermedida

layout_and_structure.pattern: Editorial Cyber Guide Structure inspired by ia-espana.es with elevated high-trust Cibermedida styling

sections.name: Navbar & Floating Bar
sections.details: Glassmorphic backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#071725]/80 border-b border-[#62E7EF]/20 sticky top-0 z-50. Logo: Cibermedida SVG mark with glowing cyan shield icon. Links: Actualidad, ¿Qué es?, Servicios, Ética & Cumplimiento, Guía de Incidentes, Ecosistema, Contacto. Emergency CTA: '¿Ataque en curso? Hotline 24/7'

sections.name: Hero Section
sections.details: Masked line-by-line kinetic title reveal: 'Protección Integral y Ciberseguridad Estratégica para la Empresa Digital'. Subtitle explaining Cibermedida's mission in Spain (Cantabria & national). Call-to-actions: 'Solicitar Auditoría 360°' and 'Ver Guía de Incidentes'. Live status indicator pulse ('Sistemas Protegidos • SOC Activo').

sections.name: Live Telemetry & Metrics Strip
sections.details: Interactive metrics bar with subtle counter animations: 500+ Recursos de Seguridad, +120 Empresas Defendidas, 99.9% Uptime SOC, 15 min Tiempo de Respuesta ante Incidentes.

sections.name: Actualidad & Inteligencia de Amenazas (News Grid)
sections.details: Grid of 6 curated original cybersecurity news cards (e.g. 'Directiva NIS2 en España', 'Resiliencia Operativa DORA', 'Inteligencia Artificial en Hacking Ético', 'Protección Ransomware en PYMEs', 'Firma Digital Acreditada', 'Auditorías Cero Confianza'). Filtering by category (Noticias, Normativa, Guías, Amenazas).

sections.name: ¿Qué es la Ciberseguridad Organizacional?
sections.details: Editorial split layout: Dark clipped image frame with high-tech server/code aesthetic on left, narrative explanation on right with interactive tabbed pillars (Confidencialidad, Integridad, Disponibilidad, Trazabilidad).

sections.name: Servicios de Seguridad y Transformación
sections.details: Card grid with hover glow borders: Auditoría y Pentesting, SOC Gestionado 24/7, Cumplimiento Normativo (ENS / ISO 27001 / NIS2), Formación y Concienciación (Capacitación a empleados), Firma Digital y Evidencia Electrónica, Consultoría de IA Segura.

sections.name: Ética, Gobernanza y Cumplimiento Normativo
sections.details: Asymmetric layout detailing legal compliance, NIS2, DORA, y Esquema Nacional de Seguridad (ENS). Checkmark list with interactive compliance checklist preview.

sections.name: Guía Práctica Ante Incidentes de Seguridad
sections.details: Interactive 4-step accordion protocol (1. Contención Inmediata, 2. Análisis Forense, 3. Notificación Legal/AEPD, 4. Mitigación y Restablecimiento). Includes a quick triage tool for users.

sections.name: Ecosistema Cibermedida y Partners
sections.details: Partner cards & badges featuring certified alliances (INCIBE, CCN-CERT, ISO/IEC, CNI-CCN). Highlights 360° protection coverage.

sections.name: Cibermedida: Tu Referencia de Confianza
sections.details: 3 core pillars section: Experiencia Comprobada, Repositorio Abierto de +500 Recursos, Cercanía y Respuesta Inmediata. Emergency CTA card: '¿Has sufrido un incidente o sospechas de una brecha?'

sections.name: Contacto Directo y Evaluación Gratis
sections.details: Functional contact form with fields: Nombre, Empresa, Teléfono, Correo Electrónico, Tipo de Servicio, Mensaje. Immediate toast response with simulated submission handling.

sections.name: Footer Editorial
sections.details: Comprehensive footer with quick links, compliance certifications, newsletter subscribe, location info (Cantabria / España), and copyright.

interactive_components: Threat Level Triage Quiz (Interactive mini-widget to assess company cyber risk level)
News Category Filter (Noticias, Guías, Regulaciones, Alertas)
Incident Response Accordion with downloadable steps simulator
Contact Form with direct Sonner notification feedback and validation
Smooth Scroll navigation targeting explicit section anchors
Search bar for Cibermedida's resource repository preview

accessibility_and_testing.contrast_ratio: APCA high contrast dark theme - Text #EEFBFF against #071725 background ratio > 12:1
accessibility_and_testing.testing_attribute: Every interactive button, link, form field, modal trigger, card and metric must have explicit data-testid attribute in kebab-case format (e.g. data-testid='hero-cta-button', data-testid='contact-submit-button', data-testid='news-card-1').

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all code files are in JS/JSX format as specified in the environment.
Do not use transparent backgrounds on dropdowns or overlay menus; use solid #102B49 or dark glass with heavy blur and 1px cyan border.
Incorporate framer-motion animations for entrance reveals, subtle cyan glows, and interactive cards.
Write rich, authentic Spanish content specific to cybersecurity in Spain (referencing NIS2, DORA, ENS, AEPD, INCIBE, SOC, ISO 27001).
Make sure all interactive buttons and inputs have proper hover, focus, and data-testid attributes.
Use sonner for form completion toast notifications.
